title: Ines and the Radiators
author: Beatrix Voss
blurb: Theo Almeida, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
